purpose: Static contract for Infinite Domain's central continent, north/south zones, east/west continents and Abyssal oceans, plus multiplayer-safe quest-independent structure spawning.

checks.check: the maintained normal preset and gradient datapack are globally active
checks.detail: Moonlight points at datapacks; normal and extended tags expose only minecraft:normal; pack format is 48

checks.check: minecraft:normal owns the Wastelands overworld routing
checks.detail: noise settings wastelands:wasteland with the Isekai climate-zone source and Wastelands fallback

checks.check: vanilla Overworld terrain consumes the custom continent and abyssal-depth chains
checks.detail: overworld/continents delegates to custom_worldgen:continents and overworld/depth subtracts abyssal_floor_depression

checks.check: the central main continent is guaranteed through radius 4000 and feathers to ocean by 4800
checks.detail: radial mask is 1/1/0.5/0 at r=0/4000/4400/4800 and the central branch never falls below continentalness 0.05

checks.check: east/west prefer recurring large continents while north/south remain ocean-separated
checks.detail: the directional mask selects opposite branches on cardinal axes; the east/west branch is exactly 0.50 more land-biased under identical noise

checks.check: north is cold, south is hot, and the central/east/west land regimes stay temperate
checks.detail: regional_temperature resolves to -1/+1 on the north/south axes and 0 on center/east/west

checks.check: Pelagos and Karsic abyssal deformation is confined to the west/east ocean corridors
checks.detail: the corridor mask is active only on the X axis; side selectors are mutually exclusive; both continent pressure and direct floor depth consume the paired depressions

checks.check: all eight depth-graded abyssal biomes and the neutral seam are routable
checks.detail: four Pelagos/Karsic band pairs keep exact humidity and continentalness ranges; -0.2..0.2 stays vanilla deep ocean

checks.check: the implemented eastern Karsic land zone is reachable without changing the central continent
checks.detail: five humidity-gated Karsic rules and biome files precede the ungated temperate Wastelands fallback; Pelagos land remains plan-deferred

checks.check: cold northern and hot southern land/ocean biome families remain complete
checks.detail: required polar and warm biome families remain represented in their saturated temperature bands

checks.check: high-fanout horizontal geography fields retain chunk-local caches
checks.detail: central/directional continents, climate routing, abyssal band masks, and repeated feature patterns are cache_2d or flat_cache wrapped

checks.check: structure spawning is datapack-owned and independent of quests, players, and teams
checks.detail: 290 structures and 152 structure sets use standard worldgen placement with registered references; no scripted quest-placement bridge exists

checks.check: land-only Wasteland caves retain literal hex geometry and world-seeded plasma occlusion
checks.detail: the canonical final-density graph consumes the project-owned hex codec only on land, protects radius 288, and contains no quest/player/team gate

runtime_validation: This gate proves file-backed topology, routing, registration, and multiplayer ownership. Fresh-world terrain appearance, structure placement quality, and generation performance remain runtime checks.
